title: Kaisi Hai Ye Islam
body:
kaisi hai ye islam ke suraj ki ziya dekh
<<DIVIDER>>
ay sheh ke azadaar zara hosh mein aaja
kufe se ubharte huwe suraj ko zara dekh
kaisi hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ikhlaq o murawwat ki ye meraj hai wallah
ek hurr ki khata dekh shahe deen ki ata dekh
kaisi hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
panja ye nahi mere tasavvur mein alam par
abbas hai pehne huwe ye taaj e wafa dekh
kaisi hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay qatil e masoom zara khauf e khuda kar
nawak ko zara dekh zara nanha gala dekh
kaisi hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
behlaati thi asghar ko ye keh keh ke sakina
tere liye pani abhi laate hai chacha dekh
kaisi hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-ghusl o kafan dafn hui naazon ki paali
kis haal mein aayi hai sakina ko qaza dekh
kaisi hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
baalon se na chehre ko chupaye to kare kya
afos mayassar nahi zainab ko rida dekh
kaisi hai ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
mehshar tere ash'aar to hai apni jagah par
ye seena zani dekh ye nazim ki sada dekh
kaisi hai ye...
author: Mehshar Lakhnavi
